name: AI access
description: Which MCP clients may drive a running app's live document: AIAccessGrants (ask, allow once, always for a client per app, deny, revoke; a file command always asks), AIAccessRequest and AIAccessEntry, FakeAIAccess (whose demo client asks again once after its first Stop), the approval flow the sheet, the chip and Window > AI Access… run on, and AIAccessPrompt, their copy and the -AIAccessDemoRequest launch hook (MC-12). afterglow-mcp MC-1 declares them as stubs; MC-9 fills the grants.
